items.title: A 'rebellious' exoplanet orbits in the opposite direction of its star
items.summary: A star and its planets form when a cloud of gas and dust collapses in on itself somewhere in space. The cloud then forms a disk around the nascent star, within which the planets will form. This protostar and its disk then rotate in the same direction.
